resolutions.note: The order's own section 6-304 reads 'This Order shall be effective March 26, 1978.' (signed March 27, 1978), so the self-executing commands of sections 1-1 and 6-2 were performed on the stated retroactive effective date, one day before signing; the recorded end date is that effective date, not the signing date.
